title: Poly(A)-capture full-length double-strand cDNA sequencing for transcriptome analysis
description: We tried two methods which are the DNase I treated full-length double-strand cDNA sequencing and the poly(A) capture full-length double-strand cDNA sequencing to avoid the non-specific genomic DNA amplification. Overall design: Transcriptome analysis by Total RNA, DNaseI-treated and Poly(A) capture Sequencing.

runs.experiment_title: NextSeq 500 sequencing: GSM5769207: genome Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
